select
  s.id ,
  s.store_no,
  s.store_name,
  cast(s.management_type_code as bigint) as store_sale_type,
  cast(s.store_type_code as bigint) as store_type_code,
  s.city_id,
  s.city_name ,
  s.region_code,
  g.store_group_name as region_name,

  s.manager_name ,

  s.close_time ,
  s.status ,

  s.decoration_code,
  if(s.flag=16, 1, 0) as is_day_clear,
  date_sub(current_date(), 1) as dt
 from dim.ods_dim_store_f s
 left join (
    select
        store_no,
        sum(store_area1) as store_area1,
        sum(store_area2) as store_area2
    from
        (
        SELECT
        store_no,
        area as store_area1,
        0 as  store_area2
        from dim.ods_dim_store_area_info_f
        where area_type_no in ('7') -- 经营面积

        union all

        SELECT
        store_no,
        0 as store_area1,
        area as  store_area2
        from dim.ods_dim_store_area_info_f
        where area_type_no in ('8') -- 实际面积
        ) a
    group by     store_no
    ) s1 on s.store_no=s1.store_no
 left join dim.ods_dim_store_group_f g
